messages:
maria: Heads up: AMS GPU pool hit 95%+ and throttled new attaches after the 09:12 deploy. We shifted burst to IAD and SFO; user impact minimal but tail latency spiked. Starting a thread to collect runbook updates & action items.

kevin: Thanks. What triggered the saturation? model rollout? warm pools?

maria: Rolling out v3-rewrite on many small slices. Batching changed; more long seq requests. Warm pool didn't pre-warm enough. Also eviction churn.

ashley: Observed node eviction due to OOM on 09:14 logs. Pasting small logs: ```kubectl logs gpu-pod-xyz OOMKilled```

sam: Can we add a preflight check to blocked rollouts if region reserve < 15%? We had only 8% reserve.

kevin: Agree. Also need cooldown on traffic shifts: current script does immediate weight change. Suggest: staged weights + 5m soak + metrics gate (attach rate, latency).

leo: I'll PR a runbook edit: add 'validate reserve >= 15%' and 'staged weighted shift' with metrics thresholds. Assign to me.

ops-eng: Cost note: bursting to IAD added ~12% cost for the hour. Need to add cost alert when cross-region spill > 10% of regional capacity.

maria: :thumbsup: add cost alert as optional step. Also we should update our autoscaler to consider seq_len distribution before scaling.

natalie: Two action items: 1) PR runbook (leo) 2) Modify deploy gating (sam) 3) Add alert in Cost dashboard (ashley). I'll create tickets and link them to the incident.

sre-bot: Incident closed — severity: low, duration: 42m, runbook updated pending.

maria: Thanks. Quick checklist to include in runbook snippet: ```- check reserve: GET /infra/reserve?region=ams
- if reserve < 15% -> block rollout
- shift staged weights: 10/30/60 with 5m soak
- monitor attach_rate, p50/p99 latency, eviction_rate
- rollback on >2% error increase
```

kevin: Also add 'warm-pool prefill: ensure warm nodes >= expected concurrent slices' and 'lambda to compute seq_len percentile from traces' to the ops playbook.

maria: Noted. Will sync on retro doc tomorrow. Thanks all :coffee:
